title: Installing Cloud Code in Visual Studio Code and JetBrains IDEs
content:
To install Cloud Code in Visual Studio Code:
- Select a Cloud Enterprise account and ensure it has access to the chosen directory and its subfolders.
- Open the extensions panel in Visual Studio Code and search for Cloud Code.
- The extension by Anthropic should have a blue checkmark, which should be installed.
- Restart Visual Studio Code after installation.
- Open the control palette with Control or Command and Shift and P, then search for Cloud Code.
- Open a new tab or click on the Cloud logo when a file is open.
- Alternatively, use the terminal experience directly in settings file.
- For JetBrains IDEs, install the Cloud Code plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace.
- Restart the IDE after installation.
raw_text: Cloud Enterprise account, be sure to select that option. Whatever directory you decide to run Cloud in, it will have access to that directory and all of its subfolders. In Visual Studio Code, open up your extensions panel and search for Cloud Code. You will see the extension by Anthropic. Make sure it has the blue check and hit install. After installation, you might need to restart VS Code. After that, you can open up the control palette with control or command and shift and P and search Cloud Code. Open a new tab. You can also click on the Cloud logo if you see it when a file is open. You can also opt out of the UI and just use the terminal experience directly in your settings file. For JetBrains IDEs, you can install the Cloud Code plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace. Once you install, restart your IDE.
